passages.quote:
This notice lists all the merchant shipping notices, marine guidance notes and marine information notes which provide standards or guidance in respect of UK implementation of the Maritime Labour Convention, 2006. It includes amendments published since 2014 and replaces MGN 470 (M) amendment 2.

Providing a comprehensive list for reference in order to ensure compliance in all respects of the Maritime Labour Convention, 2006. Annex 1 attached, summarises the implementing legislation and related notices.

Amendment 3 includes new and amended legislation and guidance published since 2014.

Notice to:

shipowners

operators

seafarers

manning agents and manning agencies
